question: What is the meaning of decomposability in relation to recycling and re-use potentials?
description: Decomposability in relation to recycling and re-use potentials refers to the ability of materials or products to be broken down into simpler components or elements that can be reused or recycled effectively. This characteristic is important in the context of circular economy practices as it influences the ease and efficiency of reusing or recycling materials and products to minimize waste and promote sustainability.
